subject: School Committee Pay Parity Proposal
overview: The Council referred a controversial proposal to increase School Committee salaries to committee following significant public opposition from educators. The body also ordained a new zoning overlay for the Wellington station area to comply with the MBTA Communities Act.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved meeting records from November 28, 2023, and reports from subcommittees regarding the budget ordinance, MBTA zoning, private ways, and zoning RFP.

items.title: Personal Privilege Regarding Councilor Absence
items.summary: Councilor Knight addressed the council and public to explain his recent absence was due to a personal family tragedy.

items.title: Petitions for Deed Restriction and Signage Appeals
items.summary: Continued a petition to amend a deed restriction at 12 Dell Avenue to December 19, and referred an appeal regarding a sign denial for Raising Cane's to subcommittee.

items.title: Claims, Donations, and Grants
items.summary: Approved a $4,000 insurance settlement for property damage, accepted a $500 park donation, and approved a $12,500 grant from Trees Medford for a public tree inventory.

items.title: Loan Order for Water System Improvements
items.summary: Approved for first reading a $3,422,000 loan order for constructing and reconstructing water mains.

items.title: Proposed School Committee Compensation Adjustment
items.summary: Referred a proposal to raise School Committee salaries to match City Council pay to the Committee of the Whole with amendments. Dozens of teachers and paraprofessionals spoke in opposition, arguing that the 140% increase was inappropriate while school staff struggle with low wages and pending contracts.

items.title: Public Participation Regarding Neighborhood Development
items.summary: A resident voiced concerns regarding the negative impacts of professional developers building luxury condos on Winter Street, citing noise and construction infractions.

items.title: Home Rule Petition for Joseph Albino
items.summary: Approved a home rule petition to allow a former firefighter to convert his accidental disability retirement to a superannuation retirement to avoid restrictive earnings caps.

items.title: Public Hearing on MBTA Community Zoning Overlay
items.summary: Ordained a new zoning overlay district for the Wellington station area to comply with state law, including a lot size reduction from 10,000 to 7,000 square feet. The overlay allows for multi-family and mixed-use development as-of-right near transit.

items.title: Solid Waste Ordinance Update
items.summary: Approved for first reading a comprehensive update to the solid waste ordinance, which introduces bundled recycling service requirements for private haulers.

items.title: South Border Road Streetlight Safety
items.summary: Referred a resolution to subcommittee to coordinate with state agencies and National Grid regarding malfunctioning streetlights creating public safety hazards.
